Q5291.reason: Reckless indifference to consequences suggests only recklessness, which supports battery (reckless application of force) rather than intent-based attempt or assault-with-intent crimes.

Q5292.reason: Hypotension and tachycardia signal significant blood loss, while beta-blockers can mask tachycardia so an 80/min pulse isn't reassuring.

Q5297.reason: Intrusion upon seclusion applies because a hotel room occupant has a reasonable expectation of privacy, and electronic eavesdropping is an intrusion without needing physical entry or publication.
